description: This source file implements a hashmap-based data structure for managing object IDs (OIDs). It provides functions to initialize, clear, insert, retrieve, and remove entries in the oidmap, which maps object identifiers to arbitrary data. The code includes internal comparison functions and interacts extensively with the 'hashmap' utility.

methods.name: int oidmap_neq(const void * hashmap_cmp_fn_data UNUSED,const struct hashmap_entry * e1,const struct hashmap_entry * e2,const void * keydata)
methods.description: Comparison function used to determine inequality between two hashmap entries based on object ID equality.

methods.name: void oidmap_init(struct oidmap * map,size_t initial_size)
methods.description: Initializes the oidmap with a specified initial size.

methods.name: void oidmap_clear(struct oidmap * map,int free_entries)
methods.description: Clears all entries in the oidmap, optionally freeing entries.

methods.name: void * oidmap_get(const struct oidmap * map,const struct object_id * key)
methods.description: Retrieves data associated with a specific object ID key from the map.

methods.name: void * oidmap_remove(struct oidmap * map,const struct object_id * key)
methods.description: Removes an entry associated with the specified object ID key from the map.

methods.name: void * oidmap_put(struct oidmap * map,void * entry)
methods.description: Inserts or updates an entry in the map.
